-- Dimensions:
--   activities.week_start
--   activities.pace_bucket

-- Metrics:
--   run_time_h
WITH "aql__t4" AS (
  -- Dimensions:
  --   activities.week_start
  --   activities.pace_bucket
  --   activities.pace_bucket_num
  -- Metrics:
  --   sum(activities.moving_time_s)
  SELECT
    (date_trunc('week', "activities"."start_local")::date) AS "activities->week_start",
    CASE
    WHEN ("activities"."avg_speed_ms" IS NULL) THEN 'unknown'
    WHEN ("activities"."avg_speed_ms" > 4.16667) THEN '<4:00'
    WHEN ("activities"."avg_speed_ms" > 3.33333) THEN '4–5'
    WHEN ("activities"."avg_speed_ms" > 2.77778) THEN '5–6'
    WHEN ("activities"."avg_speed_ms" > 2.381) THEN '6–7'
    ELSE '7+'
    END AS "activities->pace_bucket",
    CASE
    WHEN ("activities"."avg_speed_ms" IS NULL) THEN -1
    WHEN ("activities"."avg_speed_ms" > 4.16667) THEN 1
    WHEN ("activities"."avg_speed_ms" > 3.33333) THEN 2
    WHEN ("activities"."avg_speed_ms" > 2.77778) THEN 3
    WHEN ("activities"."avg_speed_ms" > 2.381) THEN 4
    ELSE 5
    END AS "activities->pace_bucket_num",
    SUM("activities"."moving_time_s") AS "sum_activities->moving_time_s"
  FROM
    activities "activities"
  WHERE
    (
      (CAST ( "activities"."start_local"::date AS date ) >= CAST ( '2026-07-24' AS date )) AND
      (CAST ( "activities"."start_local"::date AS date ) < CAST ( '2026-10-22' AS date ))
    ) AND
    ("activities"."sport_group" IN ('run')) AND
    ("activities"."moving_time_s" > 0)
  GROUP BY
    1,
    2,
    3
)
SELECT
  "aql__t3"."activities->week_start" AS "week_start",
  "aql__t3"."activities->pace_bucket" AS "bucket",
  "aql__t3"."activities->pace_bucket_num" AS "bucket_num",
  ("aql__t3"."sum_activities->moving_time_s" / 3600.0) AS "hours"
FROM
  "aql__t4" "aql__t3"
ORDER BY
  1 ASC,
  3 ASC
